test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They are building a new hospital in the city.

options.text: A new hospital was built in the city by them.
A new hospital has been built in the city by them.
A new hospital will be built in the city by them.
A new hospital is being built in the city by them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They are building a new hospital in the city."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a new hospital" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "are building" to "is being built" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the location phrase "in the city" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A new hospital is being built in the city by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A new hospital was built in the city by them." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"A new hospital has been built in the city by them." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"A new hospital will be built in the city by them." – Incorrect tense (future simple passive).
